# kubernetes — 2018 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 13 kubernetes CVEs of 2018 are in `data/cve/vendors/kubernetes/2018.jsonl`.

### CVE-2018-1002103
- Assigner: kubernetes | Published: 2018-12-05 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: Improper Input Validation
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`

In Minikube versions 0.3.0-0.29.0, minikube exposes the Kubernetes Dashboard listening on the VM IP at port 30000. In VM environments where the IP is easy to predict, the attacker can use DNS rebinding to indirectly make requests to the Kubernetes Dashboard, create a new Kubernetes Deployment running arbitrary code. If minikube mount is in use, the attacker could also directly access the host filesystem.

Affected:
- Kubernetes / Minikube: affected v0.3.0 <unspecified (custom); affected unspecified <v0.30.0 (custom)

Credits: Reported by Alex Kaskasoli

References:
- https://github.com/kubernetes/minikube/issues/3208 [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2018-1002105
- Assigner: kubernetes | Published: 2018-12-05 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: Unchecked Error Condition
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- Exploit-DB 46053: Kubernetes - (Authenticated) Arbitrary Requests (remote/multiple, 2018-12-10, verified=0)
- Exploit-DB 46052: Kubernetes - (Unauthenticated) Arbitrary Requests (remote/multiple, 2018-12-10, verified=0)

In all Kubernetes versions prior to v1.10.11, v1.11.5, and v1.12.3, incorrect handling of error responses to proxied upgrade requests in the kube-apiserver allowed specially crafted requests to establish a connection through the Kubernetes API server to backend servers, then send arbitrary requests over the same connection directly to the backend, authenticated with the Kubernetes API server's TLS credentials used to establish the backend connection.

Affected:
- Kubernetes / Kubernetes: affected v1.0.x; affected v1.1.x; affected v1.2.x; affected v1.3.x; affected v1.4.x; affected v1.5.x; affected v1.6.x; affected v1.7.x; affected v1.8.x; affected v1.9.x; affected unspecified <v1.10.11 (custom); affected unspecified <v1.11.5 (custom); affected unspecified <v1.12.3 (custom)

Credits: Reported by Darren Shepherd
